name: Destructive Fracture
evidence_scope: Current Xenoverse 2-specific mechanics and acquisition evidence.
findings: 100-Ki Strike Super from PQ145. The user strikes and binds the opponent with Hakai energy before kicking them away; current dedicated evidence also documents that the resulting knockback can be followed by an Ultimate or movement. Existing all-CaC-races scope and the PQ145 endpoint are retained. Exact bind duration, startup/recovery frames, hit-confirm timing, and damage scaling remain unresolved.
evidence_boundaries: Unsupported exact frames, scaling formulas, probabilities, hidden conditions, and patch-independent balance values were not inferred.
Source-reported numerical values remain bounded evidence.
